title: Generative data assimilation highlights fronts as key regulators of ocean energy cascade
abstract: arXiv:2608.14955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mesoscale eddies are fundamental to the ocean circulation, yet the extent to which submesoscale motions, a few kilometers across, influence mesoscale eddy energetics through a kinetic energy cascade remains uncertain. High-resolution simulations predict that submesoscale fronts are key regulators of the cascade, transferring energy both downscale towards dissipation and upscale to sustain and shape the seasonality of mesoscale eddies. Testing these predictions has remained difficult because existing observations and state estimates cannot resolve submesoscale currents over sufficiently broad domains. Here we map the ocean's submesoscale energy cascade by combining multi-source satellite observations with a generative deep learning framework, reconstructing gap-free, kilometer-scale surface currents with physically plausible dynamics learned from simulations. translated_title: 生成式数据同化揭示锋面是海洋能量级联的关键调节器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14955v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：中尺度涡旋是海洋环流的基础，然而，亚中尺度运动（几公里尺度）通过动能级联影响中尺度涡旋能量的程度仍不确定。高分辨率模拟预测，亚中尺度锋面是级联的关键调节器，既能将能量向下传递至耗散尺度，也能向上传递以维持和塑造中尺度涡旋的季节性变化。由于现有观测和状态估计无法在足够广泛的区域内解析亚中尺度流场，测试这些预测一直困难重重。在此，我们通过将多源卫星观测与生成式深度学习框架相结合，绘制海洋亚中尺度能量级联图，重建了无间隙、千米级尺度的表层流场，其物理动力学特征从模拟中学习而来。将该方法应用于涡旋丰富的阿古拉斯海流系统，我们发现亚中尺度过程在能量传递中起主导作用。
tldr: 本文利用生成式深度学习结合多源卫星数据，首次实现了对亚中尺度能量级联的高分辨率重建，揭示了锋面在调节海洋能量传递中的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This paper uses generative deep learning combined with multi-source satellite data to achieve the first high-resolution reconstruction of submesoscale energy cascade, revealing fronts as key regulators of ocean energy transfer.
